notes.note: The copyright footer has no fields: mod_footer draws two language strings. MOD_FOOTER_LINE1 carries the site name and the year, so it follows the site name override; MOD_FOOTER_LINE2 (the Joomla licence notice) is hidden by a language override with an empty value (the kit's hiddenBy). Both are overrides of the mapping file (#584).

No recipe for a search results page: no demo page shows a search box (checked on the running 1.0.11 home page: no search form), and the only route to the results page is the template showcase menu item (/pages/j-pages/smart-search), which the blank site removes with every demo menu item. A build that adds a search box later needs a recipe then.

T4_OFF_CANVAS_TITLE (Sidebar Menu): no kit page draws it (all 50 kit pages read on 1.0.11 at 390 and 1440 px)
TPL_CLOSE (Close): no kit page draws it (all 50 kit pages read on 1.0.11 at 390 and 1440 px); the Close words a page carries are the CMS's own JCLOSE string in its script options
TPL_CONTACT_ENTER_MESSAGE_PLACEHOLDER (Your message): the contact form's message placeholder, set by the template's script; a language override of the mapping file, like the form's other placeholders
TPL_DETAILS (Details): interface text valid on every site, not drawn as visible text on any kit page
TPL_FOLLOW_US (Follow us): drawn beside the footer social links at wide widths (class d-hd-inline); demo words, a language override of the mapping file
TPL_LEARNING_LEAD_DESC (All you need to know): the lead line over the punch rows of every learning post; demo words, a language override of the mapping file
TPL_LEARNING_LEAD_TITLE (The 6 punches): the heading over the punch rows of every learning post; demo words, a language override of the mapping file
TPL_NO_SUPPORT_GROUP: a warning about an unsupported listing option, no kit page draws it (all 50 kit pages read on 1.0.11 at 390 and 1440 px)
TPL_PASSWORD (Password): the login and registration form label, interface text valid on every site; drawn only on those system pages
TPL_PLAY (play): the hidden accessible name of the video play button (class d-none), interface text valid on every site
TPL_USERNAME (Username): the login and registration form label, interface text valid on every site; drawn only on those system pages
